/our-news.name: new.public.newsletter
/our-news.notes: One Livewire page (`pages::our-news`) with a nested `newsletter-subscribe` component. Reads are in NewsListQuery (lead, ordinary, pinned, headlines, edition), the cards' words in NewsPresenter, the sign-up write in SubscribeToNewsletter. Not ported: the filter window (its button was commented out of the legacy page, so it could not be opened), the page-view count and the French switch. The sign-up is a Livewire action, so legacy's POST /our-news/subscribe has no counterpart (same ten tries a minute, same messages). Deliberate differences (signed off 2026-10-16): (1) the navigation menus open (they slide); on the legacy page neither hover nor click opens them; (2) the time on the cover photo shows at every width (legacy lost it below 992px after the first redraw until the next minute); (3) a story with no photo draws no image (legacy asked picsum.photos for a stock picture, which the content security policy forbids); (4) the email is validated on the server. The story pages /our-news/{id}-{city}-{date} are linked by address and port separately.

/our-news/{id}-{city}-{date}.name: new.public.article
/our-news/{id}-{city}-{date}.notes: One Livewire page (`pages::news-article`): NewsArticleQuery finds the online story by id alone (city and date in the address are not looked at, as in legacy), RecordArticleView counts the visit (total_views every visit, view_count once per session, only when COUNT_PAGE_VIEWS is on), SafeHtml prints the editor's text. Video stories (type 3) are framed from youtube-nocookie.com; photo stories use the shared carousel and a play button that opens the shared lightbox. The sign-up box is the news list's (`site.news-signup`, narrow column). Not ported: the French switch, the Facebook SDK and Leaflet scripts the page loaded and never used, and the jquery.balloon tooltip on the paperclip. Deliberate differences (signed off 2026-10-16 for the same kind on /our-news; signed off 2026-10-16 for the rest): (1) the carousel's previous and next buttons work (legacy's carried data-bs-ride instead of data-bs-slide, so only the 5s autoplay moved the slides); (2) a wrong id, an offline story or a malformed address is a real 404 (legacy: its 404 design with a 200); the date must be eight digits; (3) the text is cut to paragraphs, line breaks, bold, italics, underline and lists with no attributes (legacy printed the editor's HTML as it was); (4) no play button for a story whose video field is not a YouTube address (news 59 holds the two characters backslash-n, and legacy drew a dead button); (5) the icons on the buttons are FontAwesome 4.7 outlines, the closest set in the repo, where legacy drew FontAwesome 6 from a CDN; (6) og:url points at /our-news/... on hcsyria.org (legacy: /newsletter/..., which does not exist); (7) the menus slide open, as on /our-news.
